Subject: Quick check on usage + scheduling a short demo

Hi Hannah,

We signed up for Redwood yesterday and have been poking around the self-serve flow — looks promising. Before we lock anything in, our product lead wants to see a quick walkthrough of how Redwood would fit into our search/QA pipeline (embeddings + reranking).

Quick context:
- Company: Olive & Co (mid-market ecom)
- Primary use case: product search relevance + auto FAQ answers for customer support
- Current volume: ~50k user queries/month, spikes to ~6 qps during peak hours
- Timeline: goal to run a pilot in Jan (2–3 months), then expand if results look good
- Data sensitivity: PII in support transcripts (redaction planned) — want to confirm private deployment options later

Could we book a 30-min walkthrough next week? Attached a small traffic snapshot (CSV) to help with sizing. Also, do you have a short checklist of pre-demo questions you typically run through so we can surface right folks?

Thanks,
Emily
Emily Johnson
Head of Product
Olive & Co

+1 415-555-0192

Hi Emily — thanks for the note and for the traffic snapshot, that helps a lot. Monica (AE) is cc'd to ensure we cover commercial fit as well.

Short checklist up front (so we can keep a 30-minute session focused):
- Primary goal for pilot (metrics you care about: CTR, NPS, resolution time)
- Data access: where transcripts/search logs live; redaction/encryption needs
- Expected workload shape: avg tokens per request, concurrency targets, percent embeddings vs. generative responses
- SSO / SAML / SCIM requirements (if any)
- Compliance asks: SOC 2, ISO, data residency

A couple quick questions based on your note:
1) For the 50k/mo — is that full requests (including rerank calls) or raw search queries?
2) During spikes (6 qps) are you expecting sustained load for minutes or short bursts lasting seconds?
3) Do you have a preferred model family (open LLMs vs. hosted proprietary)? We can recommend quantized variants if you want lower cost.

Proposed 30-minute windows next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-11-17 10:00–10:30
- Wed 2026-11-18 13:00–13:30
- Thu 2026-11-19 08:30–09:00

Or feel free to pick a time on my calendar: https://cal.redwood.com/hannah/30m

If you can reply with brief answers to the three bullets above, I’ll lock a slot and we’ll tailor the walkthrough.

Best,
Hannah Schmitt
SDR, Redwood Inference
hannah_schmitt@redwood.com

Thanks Hannah — quick answers below: 
- 50k/mo is end-user queries (we call our search service; rerank is an additional request on ~30% of queries)
- Spikes (6 qps) are usually sustained for ~10–30 minutes around peak traffic windows
- Prefer open models (cost is a concern) but willing to evaluate Redwood-curated variants for throughput/cost tradeoffs

SSO: Not needed for the pilot, but will be required for full rollout (SAML). Compliance: SOC 2 Type II is needed; we'll ask for evidence during procurement.

Wed 2026-11-18 13:00–13:30 (PST) works best for us. I booked the slot via the calendar link. Can you confirm and share any prep we should do beforehand? Also attaching a slightly larger traffic export to help sizing.

Emily
